chunks.text: Jovan Prabowo Kuncoro is a software engineer in Jakarta, Indonesia, with experience in full-stack development, ERP systems, and AI-powered applications.
Public contact: jovanku1@gmail.com. GitHub: https://github.com/Etherlyvan. CV available on request; no downloadable CV is published.
Batikpedia: Interactive 3D museum experience for Indonesian batik culture. Technologies: Next.js, Three.js, Prisma.
Genbatik: AI-powered batik generation platform using DreamBooth and ControlNet. Technologies: FastAPI, PyTorch, Docker.
RAHO ERP: Internal business application to manage operations and workflows. Technologies: Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL.
RAHO Premier — IT Support & Software Developer (Jan 2026 – Sep 2026). Developed internal business applications. Integrated Zoho Books. Conducted UAT, documentation, and user training.
Sekawan Media — Fullstack Developer (Jan 2025 – Jun 2025). Architected scalable email distribution system. Built asynchronous processing using RabbitMQ and Docker.
Genbatik — Full-Stack & AI Project (2025). Developed FastAPI backend for DreamBooth and ControlNet. Containerized application using Docker Compose, Nginx, and SSL.

Batikpedia — Full-Stack Project (2025). Developed an educational web application for Indonesian batik cultural preservation using Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and REST APIs. Built an immersive 3D museum gallery with Three.js and WebGL for an interactive browser-based experience.
